description: GeoEq is an open-source Python library for geotechnical engineering. Its documented functions address soil classification, SPT and CPT interpretation, bearing capacity, settlement, liquefaction and slope stability. Users supply site investigation measurements and design geometry; functions return calculated properties or safety measures for the chosen method. Geographic coverage is a single site or collection of sites specified by the analyst. The repository documents installation and formulas, and its GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that the many available methods are alternatives, not one calibrated ground model. Users must choose formulas appropriate to local soil and loading conditions and inspect uncertainty in input measurements. GeoEq could prepare ground parameters for bridge, building, embankment or flood-defence simulation. The related catalogue OpenSees record is a separate structural simulator, not a duplicate of these site calculations. No package or field data was downloaded.
name: GeoEq geotechnical analysis library
